purpose: Public, observed first-party role research with currentness limits for the 20 reference customer organizations. This is a source-backed research dataset, not an outreach list or native GridLens identity binding.

collection.method: Firecrawl web search and direct Firecrawl scrapes of first-party company leadership, project, and SEC pages; no Alexandria or person-enrichment providers.
collection.currentness_rule: A first-party roster shows a role as presented when retrieved; an undated page does not independently verify continued employment or the role effective date. Dated announcements remain historical.
collection.association_rule: A company leadership page supports the person's company/role association. It does not prove assignment to the named reference project unless the source explicitly says so.
collection.privacy_rule: No personal email, phone, inferred address, or private profile contact method is included. Public organizational contact pages/shared inboxes only.
collection.identity_rule: Company-site self-identification is not independent native GridLens company-domain proof. SEC proof is recorded separately with exact issuer, EIN, domain statement, source URL and quote offsets.
